content.text:
All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Critical / high deviations redlined (8):**

| Rule | Issue | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| **LOL-CAP** | §21.1 caps both parties at **one month** of Fees "without exception" — below walk-away and it overrides the Excluded Claims regime in 21.2–21.3 | Greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1M, expressly subject to Excluded Claims |
| **INDEMN** | §20 has only a sweeping one-way Customer indemnity; no Vendor indemnity, and 9.3/19.4 cross-refer to a non-existent §20.5 | Narrowed our indemnity; added Vendor IP/law/data-breach/wilful-misconduct indemnity, procedure and §20.5 infringement remedies |
| **NONCOMPETE** | §12.4 — 24-month post-term worldwide non-compete on us | Deleted (also contradicts §12.3) |
| **EXCLUSIVITY** | §2.2 — Vendor as sole and exclusive provider for the full term, no performance exit | Deleted |
| **LICENSE** | §13.1 — licence revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, Affiliates and contractors excluded | Extended to Affiliates/contractors; revocation and transfer tied to §13.3 |
| **WARRANTY** | §19.2 — 15-day Deliverable warranty with a hard "no correction or refund" cut-off that would neutralise 19.1 and 19.4 | 90 days, other warranties and remedies preserved |
| **MINCOMMIT** | §2.1 — USD 2M/year three-year take-or-pay "without reduction or termination rights" | Limited to current 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up not penalty, subject to §9.4 |
| **TRANSITION** | §11.1 — immediate deletion of Customer Data with no export, contradicting 11.2–11.3 | Six months' transition assistance; deletion only per 11.2–11.3 |

**Compliant, no redline (10):** MFN, NOSOLICIT, T4C, RENEWAL, GOVLAW, ASSIGN, IP, AUDIT, LD, INSURANCE.

Two cross-cutting points worth flagging in negotiation: several of the offending clauses (2.1, 2.2, 12.4, 11.1, 13.1, 19.2, 21.1) read as inserted overlays that contradict the surrounding drafting — §12.3 in particular already recites that we made no exclusivity, non-compete, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment, which is strong leverage for straight deletion rather than negotiation. Also note the §1.5 definition of "Fees" excludes one-time implementation charges, which thins the cap base even after our LOL-CAP fix; worth confirming the Order Form does not push material spend into that excluded bucket.
